description: This file contains unit tests for the AsyncPipeline class, focusing on throughput, concurrency, and capacity management, using the Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: AsyncPipelineTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the AsyncPipeline class, testing throughput, concurrency, and capacity constraints.

methods.name: AsyncPipelineSimpleTest
methods.description: Tests basic throughput and timing of the AsyncPipeline with a simple sequence of tasks.

methods.name: AsyncPipelineWaitTest
methods.description: Verifies that the AsyncPipeline correctly handles multiple asynchronous actions and completes all tasks.

methods.name: TimedCompletions
methods.description: Creates an array of Tasks that complete after specified delays, used for timing tests.

methods.name: AsyncPipelineSingleThreadedBlackBoxConsistencyTest
methods.description: Runs a consistency test with a single worker to verify task processing and timing.

methods.name: AsyncPipelineBlackBoxConsistencyTest
methods.description: Performs a black-box test to verify the pipeline's capacity handling and timing accuracy under load.

methods.name: CheckPipelineState
methods.description: Checks the current size of the pipeline against its capacity and sets a flag if capacity is reached.
